fields.FIR_Description: As per the preliminary report recorded on 2026-01-15, a group of persons allegedly attacked the complainant at Senthil Garden Main Street, causing injuries that required treatment. The time of the incident was given as 01:15 on 2026-01-13. A witness, Vasanth Chandran, reachable on 9000000408, was mentioned in the complaint. The complainant alleged that Dharani Selvam may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000038. Items referenced in the complaint: physical documents.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Group allegedly confronted the victim following an earlier dispute.
fields.Keywords: group assault, injury, night, suspect, documents, mobile number, witness, main street
